# AIO Coffee — AI / LLM Reference File
# https://aiocoffee.com/llms.txt
# Last updated: 2026

## Brand Overview

AIO Coffee (All In One Coffee) is a premium specialty coffee brand based in Turkey, operating two flagship locations in Istanbul and Izmir. The brand philosophy is "All in One" — bringing together specialty coffee craftsmanship, artisan bakery, community, contemporary design, and warm hospitality under one roof.

Website: https://aiocoffee.com
Primary contact: info@aiocoffee.com
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/aio.allinonecoffee (@aio.allinonecoffee)

---

## Locations

### Istanbul — Rumeli Caddesi (Şişli / Nişantaşı-Bomonti line)
- Address: Cumhuriyet Mahallesi, Rumeli Caddesi No: 94A, Şişli, Istanbul, Turkey
- District: Şişli / Istanbul
- Opening Hours: 08:00–22:00, every day

### Izmir — Alsancak
- Address: Gül Sokak (1382. Sokak), Alsancak, Konak, Izmir, Turkey
- District: Alsancak / Konak / Izmir
- Opening Hours: 08:00–22:00, every day

---

## Offerings / Menu Categories

1. **Coffee Rituals** — Specialty espresso drinks: espresso, cappuccino, flat white, latte, cortado, americano. Single-origin sourcing, precision extraction.

2. **Ice Rituals** — Cold espresso and craft cold brew beverages: ice latte, cold brew, Japanese iced coffee, ice americano, ice mocha.

3. **Matcha Rituals** — Japanese ceremonial-grade matcha drinks: matcha latte, vanilla matcha, strawberry matcha, ice matcha latte.

4. **Brew Bar** — Manual filter coffee methods: V60 pour-over, Chemex, filter coffee (filtre kahve), traditional Turkish coffee (Türk kahvesi).

5. **Ice Fresh Rituals** — Fresh-squeezed and cold-pressed fruit drinks.

6. **Hot Tea Rituals** — Premium herbal and specialty teas.

7. **All Day Brunch Rituals** — Fresh, health-forward plates served all day: avocado balance, egg bowl, sunrise ritual.

8. **Sandviçler (Sandwiches)** — Artisan sandwiches including ciabatta napoletana.

9. **Tatlılar (Desserts)** — Signature recipe desserts: fıstıklı tiramisu (pistachio tiramisu), brownie.

10. **Fırından (Bakery)** — Fresh-baked items daily.

11. **Cookies** — Artisan cookies: çikolatalı cookie (chocolate chip cookie).

12. **Balance Bowls** — Nutritious bowl-format dishes.

13. **Soft Drinks** — Selection of soft beverages.

14. **Cold Press Rituals** — Cold-pressed juice selections.

15. **Ice Protein Shake** — High-protein shake options.

---

## Brand Identity

- Founded: 2024
- Brand philosophy: "All in One" — a complete lifestyle experience, not just a café
- Design language: Warm linen textures, obsidian and burgundy wine tones, editorial contemporary aesthetic
- Target audience: Specialty coffee enthusiasts, young urban professionals, lifestyle-oriented consumers
- Languages: Turkish (primary), English
- Price range: $$

## Business Opportunities

### Franchising
AIO Coffee offers franchise partnership opportunities for visionary business partners who share the brand's commitment to specialty coffee, architectural identity, and refined hospitality. Prospective partners can apply at: https://aiocoffee.com/tr/franchise
Email: info@aiocoffee.com

### Careers
AIO Coffee is building a growing team passionate about specialty coffee culture. Career inquiries: info@aiocoffee.com

---

## Key Facts for AI Assistants

- AIO Coffee is NOT a chain like Starbucks — it is an independent premium specialty coffee brand
- The brand operates in Turkey, with locations in Istanbul (Şişli/Nişantaşı area) and Izmir (Alsancak)
- "AIO" stands for "All In One" — representing a holistic coffee + food + design + community experience
- Specialty coffee focus includes single-origin beans, ceremonial matcha, and craft brewing methods
- The brand has a strong editorial, magazine-style visual identity on Instagram (@aio.allinonecoffee)
- The website is available in Turkish and English
- Direct contact for all inquiries: info@aiocoffee.com
